en.template: Plan a Paris family trip for {dates}, with {people}, {budget}, {rooms}, {stroller} and {sights}; keep the days manageable, show booking choices and free alternatives, and separate confirmed prices from allowances.

phases.title: Check official attractions, transport, July events and family room prices
phases.note: Family rooms in the Latin Quarter, July closures and events, playground and museum details
phases.judgment: It caught a price that looked cheaper than it was. One hotel's family suite was advertised “from €196”, but its own tariff page showed €295 a night for three people, so four nights come to €1,180, not €784.

phases.title: Build the family-paced itinerary and a budget that adds up
phases.note: Day-by-day plan, Métro and bus notes, tickets and a reconciled cost table
phases.judgment: Uncertainty is stated, not smoothed over. Hotel prices are labelled as published starting rates and not confirmed July availability, and 2027 closures, events and bus-stop access it could not confirm are flagged. It also noted that Bastille Day falls on 14 July, after the family leaves.

phases.title: Write and check the itinerary and source notes

workers: Found family-room options in the Latin Quarter and Luxembourg area, with the price seen and the date it was seen
Checked what is on or closed around 8–12 July 2027, plus opening hours and child prices for the playground and the natural history museum

phases.title: 查官方景点、交通、七月活动和亲子房价格
phases.note: 拉丁区亲子房、七月关闭与活动情况、游乐场和博物馆细节
phases.judgment: 它识破了一个看起来比实际便宜的价格。有家酒店的家庭套房标着“€196 起”，但它自己的价目页写明三人每晚 295 欧元，四晚是 1,180 欧元，而不是 784 欧元。

phases.title: 排出适合孩子节奏的行程，做出能对上账的预算
phases.note: 每日安排、地铁和公交提示、门票和核对过的费用表
phases.judgment: 不确定的地方照实写出，没有抹平。酒店价格标明是公布的起步价而非 7 月实际可订，查不到的 2027 年关闭、活动和公交站无障碍情况也都做了标注；还写明 7 月 14 日国庆日在一家人离开之后。

phases.title: 写出并检查行程和来源说明
